parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range for filtering by creation time. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the stack list.  

Start value: 1.
  
Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page when paging is used.  

Maximum value: 50.
  
Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ParentStackId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent stack.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the stack. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.  
For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?](~~94475~~).

parameters.name: ShowNestedStack
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to list nested stacks. Valid values:

- true
- false (default)
  
> If ParentStackId is specified, this value is set to true.

parameters.name: StackId
parameters.description: The stack ID. If you do not need detailed stack information, you can specify this parameter instead of calling the GetStack operation.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range for filtering by creation time. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the stack.  
Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the stack.  
Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
